## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: pre-commit-test-gate.sh, pre-commit-review-gate.sh, review-gate.sh (PreToolUse), and their .pre-commit-config.yaml entries are removed (partial: test-gate portion)
- DD4: COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md Step 3.5 (the test-status recording script) is removed, eliminating unnecessary test recording on every commit
- DD5: All test files testing removed hooks (partial: test-gate test files) and their .test-index entries are removed in the same commit

## Implementation Plan

### Files to DELETE (in single commit):
- `plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh` — the hook itself
- `plugins/dso/hooks/record-test-status.sh` — only consumer was pre-commit-test-gate.sh
- `plugins/dso/hooks/compute-diff-hash.sh` — only consumer was record-test-status.sh via test gate
- `tests/hooks/test-pre-commit-test-gate.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-pre-commit-test-gate-resource-exhaustion.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-test-gate-coexistence.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-test-gate-fast-path.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-accumulative.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-attest.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-batch-threshold.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-centrality.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-eagain.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-part1.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-part2.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-part3.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-part4.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-red-zone-merge.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-split-guard.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-staged-test-no-source.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-stale-failure-warn.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-record-test-status-worktree-cwd.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-compute-diff-hash.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-compute-diff-hash-autostash-invariance.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-compute-diff-hash-tickets-tracker.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-compute-diff-hash-tickets.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-integration-eagain-full-path.sh`
- `tests/hooks/test-hook-inline-trap-consolidation.sh` (verify it primarily tests test-gate hooks before deleting)

### Files to UPDATE (in same commit):
- `.pre-commit-config.yaml`: remove the `pre-commit-test-gate` hook entry
- `.test-index`: remove all entries for the deleted source files above
- `plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md`: remove Step 3.5 reference to the test-status recorder

### Authorization Note:
This task removes safeguard files (pre-commit-test-gate.sh) as part of user-authorized story 5428-bebd. CLAUDE.md rule #22 (safeguard approval required) is satisfied by the epic's brainstorm+preplanning pipeline.

### Decision on record-review.sh:
Do NOT remove record-review.sh in this task. The review WORKFLOW remains (code-reviewer agents still write reviewer-findings.json); only the gate enforcement is removed. record-review.sh fate is addressed in a separate task.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] pre-commit-test-gate.sh is removed from filesystem
  Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-test-gate.sh
- [ ] The test-status recording script is removed from filesystem
  Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/record-test-status.sh
- [ ] compute-diff-hash.sh is removed from filesystem
  Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/compute-diff-hash.sh
- [ ] .pre-commit-config.yaml no longer contains pre-commit-test-gate hook entry
  Verify: ! grep -q 'pre-commit-test-gate' .pre-commit-config.yaml
- [ ] .test-index contains no references to deleted source files
  Verify: ! grep -qE 'pre-commit-test-gate|compute-diff-hash' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Remove pre-commit test gate and all associated scripts and tests
